assessment.sentence_structure: Seven conservative rhetorical families; fragment styles, ordered searches and setting contrasts are merged, not counted independently.
assessment.pacing: Brief direct action, staccato fragments, sequential reading, and longer contrast/reflection paragraphs.
assessment.information_order: All discoveries remain last by design; order within the descriptive prelude varies. No claim of unlimited plot ordering.
assessment.sensory_detail: Rain and crowd sound draw on the public scene; gesture and attention remain incidental.
assessment.cohesion: All lead into the same clue. The fixed paragraph break remains audible, particularly after the reflective and understated openings.
assessment.repetition: Shared board/patrol references remain; generic neutral matrix prelude is deliberately repetitive and shows no expressive gain.
assessment.naturalness: Editorially broader than enum templates; fragments may feel mannered, and hand selection favors the prototype.
assessment.mechanical_consistency: All ten reviewed examples retain exact discovery and add no consequences.
